title: Structural basis of p53 inactivation by cavity-creating cancer mutations and its implications for the development of mutant p53 reactivators.
authors: Balourdas, Dimitrios-Ilias; Markl, Anja M; Kramer, Andreas; Settanni, Giovanni; Joerger, Andreas C
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体学和MD模拟研究p53 DNA结合域癌突变引起的空腔及稳定性变化，虽聚焦p53蛋白而非TF-DNA结合机制，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系且MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The cavity-creating p53 cancer mutation Y220C is an ideal paradigm for developing small-molecule drugs based on protein stabilization. Here, we have systematically analyzed the structural and stability effects of all oncogenic Tyr-to-Cys mutations (Y126C, Y163C, Y205C, Y220C, Y234C, and Y236C) in the p53 DNA-binding domain (DBD). They were all highly destabilizing, drastically lowering the melting temperature of the protein by 8-17  degrees C. In contrast, two non-cancerous mutations, Y103C and Y107C, had only a moderate effect on protein stability. Differential stabilization of the mutants upon treatment with the anticancer agent arsenic trioxide and stibogluconate revealed an interesting proximity effect. Crystallographic studies complemented by MD simulations showed that two of the mutations, Y234C and Y236C, create internal cavities of different size and shape, whereas the others induce unique surface lesions. The mutation-induced pockets in the Y126C and Y205C mutant were, however, relatively small compared with that of the already druggable Y220C mutant. Intriguingly, our structural studies suggest a pronounced plasticity of the mutation-induced pocket in the frequently occurring Y163C mutant, which may be exploited for the development of small-molecule stabilizers. We point out general principles for reactivating thermolabile cancer mutants and highlight special cases where mutant-specific drugs are needed for the pharmacological rescue of p53 function in tumors.
abstract_zh: 产生空腔的p53癌症突变Y220C是基于蛋白质稳定化开发小分子药物的理想范例。在此，我们系统分析了p53 DNA结合域（DBD）中所有致癌性Tyr-to-Cys突变（Y126C、Y163C、Y205C、Y220C、Y234C和Y236C）的结构和稳定性效应。它们均高度去稳定化，使蛋白质的熔解温度大幅降低8-17°C。相比之下，两个非癌性突变Y103C和Y107C对蛋白质稳定性仅有中等程度的影响。用抗癌剂三氧化二砷和锑酸葡胺处理后，突变体的差异稳定化揭示了一个有趣的邻近效应。晶体学研究辅以分子动力学（MD）模拟表明，其中两个突变Y234C和Y236C产生了大小和形状不同的内部空腔，而其他突变则诱导独特的表面损伤。然而，Y126C和Y205C突变体中突变诱导的袋状结构相对较小，与已具成药性的Y220C突变体相比。有趣的是，我们的结构研究表明，在频繁出现的Y163C突变体中，突变诱导的袋状结构具有显著的可塑性，这可能被利用于开发小分子稳定剂。我们指出了重新激活热不稳定癌症突变体的一般原则，并强调了需要突变特异性药物以实现肿瘤中p53功能药理学拯救的特殊案例。
